blocks.text: 🪝 India Overtakes US in PPP-Based Global Savings (Trails Only China). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: EAC-PM working paper reveals India's global savings share rose to 10.3% in 2025.
Global Rankings: India became the world's 2nd-largest contributor to global savings in PPP terms (10.3% share).
Top Country: China ranks 1st globally with a 31.9% share of global savings.
Historical Growth: India's share rose from 3.3% in 1992 to 10.3% in 2025.
India global savings share (10.3%, 2nd) vs China share (31.9%, 1st).
